answer: The harbor lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the terrace is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
